description: Initiative 0002 Slice 1: canonical Runs API + WDK workflow skeleton with version pinning, incremental progress, idempotent steps, and strict row invariants (placeholder rows allowed until extraction slices ship).

userStories.title: Start Quick Start run and observe progress
userStories.description: Start a Quick Start run on indexed/ready folders, pin versions, and expose progress and failure counts via canonical APIs with safe error envelopes.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /folders/:id/runs enforces preconditions (folders.state in {indexed, ready}); otherwise returns 409 with error.code=CONFLICT using the standard error envelope including trace_id.
Run pins index_version, agent_bundle_version, and question_set_version and returns them in the response.
GET /runs/:id returns progress and failure taxonomy counts per docs/03-architecture/50_api_surface.md.

userStories.title: Rows appear incrementally and always obey invariants
userStories.description: Rows stream into the report table as they complete, and every row obeys terminal status invariants; no duplicate (run_id, question_id) rows on restart.
acceptanceCriteria: UI reads rows via GET /folders/:id/report?run_id=... (no direct DB reads).
completed runs have exactly one row per question_id for the run's question_set_version.
missing_input rows use the exact answer string, have zero citations, and include an actionable checklist in notes/provenance.
citation_failed rows include a safe taxonomy reason code in provenance (e.g. CITATION_MISMATCH, ENTAILMENT_FAIL).
